customMethods.name: openDetailEditor
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("openDetailEditor() called")
	attributeId = self.view.custom.table.selection.data[0].attributeId
	attributeName = self.view.custom.table.selection.data[0].attributeName
	system.perspective.openPopup("attributeDetailEditor", "kanoa/mes/config/attributes/attributeDetailsEditor", params={'value':{'attributeId':attributeId}}, title='Dynamic Attribute Detail Editor - %s'%attributeName, position={'width': '980px','height': '500px'}, resizable=True, draggable=True, viewportBound=True)
	return

customMethods.name: openAttributeEditor
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.openPopup("attributeEditor", "kanoa/mes/config/attributes/attributeEditor", params={'value':{'attributeId':attributeId}}, draggable=True, title='Dynamic Attribute Editor', position={'height': 'auto'}, resizable=True, viewportBound=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteAttributes
deleteAttribute
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteAttribute() called")

	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.attribute.deleteAttribute(self.view.custom.filter.selected.attributeId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if retVal: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Attribute has been deleted'})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")

	return
